sara: Heads up — noticing missing child spans for gRPC bidi streams when pods are terminating. Root span shows up but per-request spans vanish. Anyone seen this?

miguel: Yep. Check if you're calling exporter.Shutdown or forceFlush on shutdown. Go SDK's batcher can drop spans on abrupt context cancel / os.Exit.

sara: we call grpcServer.GracefulStop() then cancel root ctx. Example shutdown flow:
```
server.GracefulStop()
cancel()
tp.Shutdown(ctxWithTimeout)
```
but I think tp.Shutdown not always runs in time.

john: if cancel() happens before Shutdown, exporter may drop. Move Shutdown before cancel, or use context with timeout separate from server ctx. Also ensure SDK version >= 1.7.0 (fixed batcher flush bug).

infra-oncall: Also check collector/otelcol:ExporterRequestsPending metric. If batcher queue large, Shutdown waits up to deadline then returns; you might need to call forceFlush prior to Shutdown.

sara: where's the dashboard for that metric?

miguel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/trace/otel-overview?orgId=1&var-service=worker — _trace_batch_size_, _exporter_queue_length_, and _otelcol_exporter_sent_count_ panels.

john: For testing, set sampler to AlwaysOn and smaller BatchSpanProcessor export timeout so flush occurs quicker:
```
batch := sdktrace.NewBatchSpanProcessor(exporter, sdktrace.WithMaxExportBatchSize(64), sdktrace.WithExporterTimeout(5*time.Second))
```
Also add grpc unary/stream interceptors:
```
otelgrpc.UnaryServerInterceptor()
otelgrpc.StreamServerInterceptor()
```

sara: i'll try ordering Shutdown before cancel and add the interceptors. If it persists i'll enable AlwaysOn for a day and post logs.

otelbot: deploy 2024-11-02 10:02 by @deploy-bot: worker v2.4 rolled to staging — no errors.

miguel: another gotcha: gRPC streaming server handlers often return after sending but if context cancels inside handler, span may be ended before exporter sees it; try ending spans after final send, or explicit span.End() after work.

sara: thanks — will update here once i have results. :thumbsup:
